title: So much fun!
text: We had an excellent time on the perfect day and met some amazing people and the crew were fantastic! The views from the water were so beautiful!

title: Great value boat trip.
text: Really nice way to spend an hour and a quarter. Lovely boat, good music, friendly crew, great photo opportunities for the Barcelona coast line, and plenty of free beer. All for less than £15 per person. What great value!

title: Great experience

title: 10/10 Barcelona experience
text: Beautiful views and a very friendly crew made this experience extremely worthwhile. We ended up buying a bottle of kava on the boat, which was very affordable and made the experience feel premium. We were also three of about ten people on the boat total, so it felt like a high-end, private experience.
